size.value: 40 x 60 mm (photo taken so that a 35 x 45 mm rectangle can be cut from it)

background.value: must maintain contrast with face, hair and clothing; must remain clear when converted to greyscale

head_height.value: 70-80% of photo height; chin to top of head 31-35mm; 2-4mm from top edge to top of head; 8-10mm from chin to bottom edge

file_spec.value: greyscale for passport; color for temporary travel document

expression_restriction.value: neutral expression; no laughing, mouth open, yawning, or frowning

glasses_policy.value: no tinted or colored lenses; frames should not cover any part of the eyes and preferably should not be heavy

headwear_policy.value: not allowed; religious exception permitted if eyes, eyebrows, cheeks, and chin remain clearly visible
